title: Evaluation the Effect of Muscle Functional Electrical Stimulation in the Upper Limb Tremor Invalidating
brief_summary: The main objective of this study is to identify the superficial muscle groups involved in gene-related tremor and assess the reduction in the intensity of the tremor after transient electrical stimulation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subject with disabling tremor of upper limb
* Subject with essential tremor action and / or lesion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subject with drug tremor
* Subject presenting an exaggerated physiological tremor
* Subject with isolated resting tremor
